guide.text: Increases Hal Jordan's HP and Attack, and turns his excess healing into an Attack bonus for allies. At the start of battle, it also grants the whole squad a shield based on Hal Jordan's Ultimate level and Attack, with double the shield strength for [Justice League] and [Green Lantern Corps] allies. A versatile choice that combines healing, shielding, and offensive support.
